chunk_024.0x174a: ＠緑▽June 6, 1991: A massive explosion of unknown cause at the Chernoton Research Institute in Moscow.
chunk_024.0x1799: ＠緑The germ weapon 'Lucifer-α', then under development by the old Soviet military, leaked into the air, causing the largest bio-hazard (biological leak) in history.
chunk_024.0x180c: ＠緑Within a week it wiped out nearly 80% of Eastern Europe and the Eurasian continent.
chunk_024.0x1855: ＠緑▽Six months later, 'Lucifer-α', closing in on Asia, mutated and turned harmless.
chunk_024.0x18a6: ＠緑▽Since then, the depopulated northern Eurasian region has remained, under the world's watchful eye, a UN neutral territory to this day.
chunk_024.0x190b: ＠緑The above events are known as 'The Catastrophe'.
chunk_024.0x1936: ＠緑▽After the incident, countless reports were filed, yet the truth of it has never been revealed.
chunk_024.0x19c9: ＠緑▽August 24, 2005: World War III breaks out over the 'UN Neutral Territory', which for 14 years since 'The Catastrophe' had been the largest buffer zone.
chunk_024.0x1a3e: ＠緑▽China gave military backing to right-wing remnants of the old Soviet army who had survived the Catastrophe, and moved to invade the neutral zone.
chunk_024.0x1aab: ＠緑▽But the West's economic blockade forced China to withdraw with little resistance, and the UN forces claimed victory.
chunk_024.0x1b00: ＠緑This war, over in a mere six months, is called the 'Half-Year War'.
chunk_024.0x1b6b: ＠緑▽Left uninhabited by the Catastrophe, the Siberian region is administered by the UN and has been abandoned as a non-intervention zone for 50 years.
chunk_024.0x1bd8: ＠緑This is because, due to the after-effects of 'Lucifer-α', no plant or animal life can grow there for the next half-century.
chunk_024.0x1c31: ＠緑▽Fearing a resurgence of 'World War III', the UN dispatches a 'Siberian Search Team' each year to keep watch over the neutral zone.
chunk_024.0x1cbc: ＠緑▽The 1987 INF Treaty (Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces) set things in motion, and strategic nuclear arms have been cut back ever since.
chunk_024.0x1d23: ＠緑▽In 2007, with the IAEA (International Atomic Energy Agency) enforcing the 'Agreement to Halt Production of Weapons-Grade Fissile Material'...
chunk_024.0x1d8e: ＠緑the military nukes of UN member states were eradicated. Some non-member states, however, are said to still produce and hold nuclear weapons.
chunk_024.0x1dfb: ＠緑Today only the so-called 'nuclear deterrent', kept under UN control for peacekeeping, remains.
chunk_024.0x1ea0: ＠緑▽A social phenomenon brought about by the SNATCHER problem.
chunk_024.0x1ecf: ＠緑Out of sheer terror of SNATCHER contamination, innocent people are denounced as SNATCHERs and beaten or killed—hysterical mob violence.
chunk_024.0x1f40:
＠緑The victims are mainly the socially vulnerable.
The name comes from its resemblance to the medieval 'witch hunts'.
chunk_024.0x1fa9: ＠緑▽The worst of it was tied to the North-South divide: mobs of the 'North' citizenry attacking residents of the 'South' slums...
chunk_024.0x2014: ＠緑A movement fueled by anti-slum sentiment, in which many people with no connection to the SNATCHERs lost their lives.
chunk_024.0x2073: ＠緑▽This 'Witch Hunt' died down once it was learned that snatching targeted only important figures, but...
chunk_024.0x20d8: ＠緑even now, certain cult groups carry on these atrocities, deepening the rift between North and South.
chunk_024.0x22c5:
＠緑It also holds the meaning '《JUNK (scrap metal)》　　　＋《ER (person)》
　　　＝scrap-metal handler'
as well.
chunk_024.0x234a:
＠緑▽April 2042
The Metropolitan Police forms the 'Anti-SNATCHER Special Police Unit'.
chunk_024.0x2387:
＠緑▽May 2042
The government intelligence agency's anti-SNATCHER science team...
chunk_024.0x2407:
＠緑▽August 2042

chunk_024.0x248e: ＠緑The Director serves as the 'Head (Brain)', along with the 'Mechanic', the 'Operator', the 'Runner' who carries out the actual investigation, and the accompanying
chunk_024.0x2546: ＠緑In addition, a forensics division called 'JUNK' is attached as a support arm.
chunk_024.0x2587: ＠緑▽The 'Mechanic' develops and maintains all equipment used by JUNKER.
chunk_024.0x25de: ＠緑▽The 'Operator' processes all data sent in from the Navigators and other sources.
chunk_024.0x2635: ＠緑▽The 'Head' grasps the whole situation and directs the Runners—the brain of the outfit.
chunk_024.0x2684: ＠緑▽The 'Runner' uses a Navigator to carry out field investigations—dangerous duty.
chunk_024.0x26d1: ＠緑▽'JUNK' handles the after-care of the scenes a Runner has dealt with.

chunk_024.0x2d8a:
＠緑▽The regulations at the base of JUNKER conduct and investigation.
They divide broadly into five.
chunk_024.0x2dd3: ＠緑1) The purpose of JUNKER is to eliminate bioroid SNATCHERs.
chunk_024.0x2e20: ＠緑2) JUNKER must not harm a human being, even to carry out the First Article.
chunk_024.0x2e75: ＠緑3) Under 'Civil Code Article 18, Clause 12: Protection of Human Rights Concerning the SNATCHER Problem', JUNKER
chunk_024.0x2ecc: ＠緑may not subject a suspect to direct investigation or physical restraint without conclusive proof that they are a SNATCHER.
chunk_024.0x2f33: ＠緑4) Under 'Criminal Code Special Provision 3: Assistance of Bounty Hunters', JUNKER...
chunk_024.0x2f88: ＠緑is obligated to cooperate with and support civilian bounty hunters.
chunk_024.0x2fc5: ＠緑5) As a special authority for carrying out the First Article, JUNKER is permitted to carry a Blaster and a Navigator.
chunk_024.0x305e: ＠緑▽Under 'Civil Code Article 18, Clause 12: Protection of Human Rights Concerning the SNATCHER Problem', citizens are granted...
chunk_024.0x30c9:
＠緑the right to refuse direct examination (scanning) by JUNKER.
JUNKER's scientific direct examination (direct scanning)
chunk_024.0x313a:
＠緑is permitted only upon presentation of a scanning warrant issued by a court.
Therefore, any and all
chunk_024.0x31a7: ＠緑scientific scanning of an individual by sensors is prohibited until a warrant is issued.
chunk_024.0x322e: ＠緑A JUNKER-only ID card that uses an IC chip.
chunk_024.0x3263: ＠緑It records every piece of personal data, including DNA patterns, to verify the holder's identity.
chunk_024.0x32e0: ＠緑A coat exclusive to Runners. Made of aramid fiber plus Flex-Armor material.
chunk_024.0x3329: ＠緑It uses two kinds of aramid fiber—meta-meta type (heat-resistant to 800°C) and para-para type (so durable a 0.1mm strand holds 50kg)—
chunk_024.0x339e:
＠緑to boost heat and impact resistance.
Flex-Armor, which hardens under pressure or impact, is also used at the collar
chunk_024.0x3405:
＠緑and chest for localized reinforcement.
Because of these materials, each coat is made to fit the Runner's build and body
chunk_024.0x34a9: ＠緑Made of shape-memory alloy, shape-memory ceramic, and thermoplastic flexible plastic.
chunk_024.0x3502: ＠緑In an emergency, applying voltage to the electrodes inside the buckle turns it into a baton.
chunk_024.0x356f: ＠緑An artificial skin-tissue spray developed through protein-engineering biochemistry.
chunk_024.0x35c8: ＠緑Applied to exposed skin, it protects the body and provides heat and shock resistance.
chunk_024.0x3613: ＠緑It allows oxygen exchange, but blocks sweat and waste, so it must be peeled off within 24 hours.
chunk_024.0x3696: ＠緑Runners, often wounded, use the two blood-replacement methods below to raise their survival odds and lower mortality.
chunk_024.0x3701:
＠緑(1) Artificial blood replacement
The subject's blood is swapped for artificial blood; the real blood is stored and swapped back as needed.
chunk_024.0x376c: ＠緑Since artificial blood can be produced and transfused without limit, there's no worry of severe blood loss.
chunk_024.0x37b3: ＠緑Purifying artificial blood strains the kidneys, however, so dialysis is required.
chunk_024.0x37fc:
＠緑(2) Self-frozen blood replacement
　　　(autologous blood doping)　The subject's own blood is enriched in advance with costly nutrients and concentrated...
chunk_024.0x386b: ＠緑then stored at minus 42°C, thawed and transfused back into the subject as needed.
chunk_024.0x3917:
＠緑A military product meant to supply adrenaline in emergencies.
It drew attention in World War III.
chunk_024.0x3968: ＠緑The adrenaline heightens a JUNKER's stability, reflexes, and stamina in a crisis.
chunk_024.0x39bb: ＠緑Prolonged use has side effects—exhaustion and fatigue. In the trade it's called 'a dose of hysterical strength'.
chunk_024.0x3a46:
＠緑Ultra-miniature medical robots.
Developed by JUNKER mechanic Harry Benson.
chunk_024.0x3aa3: ＠緑Injected into the body, they travel through the bloodstream and heal damaged areas from within.
chunk_024.0x3ae6: ＠緑Thanks to a special coating, they provoke no antibody response.
chunk_024.0x3b51: ＠緑An analysis robot that supports a Runner's investigative work.
chunk_024.0x3b84: ＠緑The Navigator mainly handles investigative analysis, recording, and communication, designed to keep JUNKER operations running smoothly.
chunk_024.0x3bf7: ＠緑It is programmed to suit each Runner's personality, and designed to support the high-stress Runner psychologically as well.
chunk_024.0x3c68: ＠緑It also carries various sensors, letting it detect any danger.
chunk_024.0x3cab: ＠緑Once a 'Scanning Warrant' is issued, it can also scan the human body.
chunk_024.0x3d00: ＠緑But it is fitted with a control circuit that ignores any such command when no 'Scanning Warrant' exists.
chunk_024.0x3d89: ＠緑An air-and-ground vehicle used by JUNKER. On land it runs on three-wheel drive; to hover or fly it retracts its wheels and switches to jet propulsion.
chunk_024.0x3df4:
＠緑Linked directly to the city's traffic control system, it can drive itself.
Switchable between auto and manual driving.
chunk_024.0x3e55: ＠緑In manual mode, the onboard computer adapts to each driver's skill and temperament to assist with the controls.
chunk_024.0x3ebe: ＠緑It has a safety feature that forcibly switches to auto control at the computer's discretion.
chunk_024.0x3f2f: ＠緑The only official firearm capable of eliminating a SNATCHER.
chunk_024.0x3f68: ＠緑Its body, made of super-engineering plastic, carbon fiber, and ceramic, is ultra-light and shows no deformation from
chunk_024.0x3fd7:
＠緑temperature change.
The grip and trigger are ergonomically designed to fit the user's hand.
chunk_024.0x4034: ＠緑It employs a feedback mechanism, so its rate of fire rises without limit to match the user's reflexes.
chunk_024.0x40bc: ＠緑▽A spider-type robot SNATCHERs use as a warning sensor.
chunk_024.0x40f5:
＠緑It spins sensor threads from its abdomen into a web; anyone who touches them is attacked with a needle gun.
Capable of jet propulsion and jumping.
chunk_024.0x416a: ＠緑'JUNK' has tried to analyze it time and again, but its self-destruct device leaves much about it unknown.
chunk_024.0x421c: ＠緑1) SNATCHERs act in winter, and only at night.
chunk_024.0x424b: ＠緑2) SNATCHERs only snatch VIPs. Their aim appears to lie not in the snatching itself, but in its secondary effects.
chunk_024.0x42be: ＠緑3) A SNATCHER's snatching ability has limits, because there are set specs to how far its body parts, joints, and skeleton can stretch.
chunk_024.0x4331: ＠緑That range is estimated at 150 to 180cm in height. Thus children and the elderly are believed to be un-snatchable.
chunk_024.0x43a6:
＠緑4) SNATCHER weapon
A laser cannon inside the mouth.
chunk_024.0x43dd:
＠緑5) SNATCHER weak point
The thinly armored slit on the head.
chunk_024.0x441a: ＠緑6) A SNATCHER's imperfect artificial skin turns cancerous under prolonged UV exposure.
chunk_024.0x4467: ＠緑7) SNATCHERs are believed to hide in areas where a special cedar known as Snow Cedar grows.
chunk_024.0x4523: ＠緑The wreckage of a bioroid is found aboard Flight SOS4003, which crashed in the Rokko Mountains.
chunk_024.0x456e:
＠緑▽February 18, 2040
A SNATCHER posing as then-Kobe Mayor B. O'Connor is arrested, but self-destructs during transport.
chunk_024.0x461c: ＠緑A movement called the 'Bioroid Hunt', reminiscent of a witch hunt, spreads across the region.
chunk_024.0x466d:
＠緑▽November 3, 2042
A KBC news anchor is exposed as a SNATCHER and eliminated. The remains are lost to self-destruction.
chunk_024.0x46d8:
＠緑▽November 15
The founder of a radical new religious sect is exposed as a SNATCHER; during pursuit, a traffic accident sets it ablaze.
chunk_024.0x4739:
＠緑▽November 20
The former president of a biotech firm is exposed as a SNATCHER and eliminated. The remains are stolen in transport.
chunk_024.0x47e0: ＠緑▽At the end of 2041, the Metropolitan Police sought public cooperation in eliminating SNATCHERs and set up the bounty system below.
chunk_024.0x4847: ＠緑Any Kobe citizen with voting rights may, through a simple process (firearms license, psychological test, JUNKER test... etc.),
chunk_024.0x48ba: ＠緑register as a bounty hunter—the 'Bounty Hunter System' now in effect.
chunk_024.0x4907: ＠緑Payment for eliminating a SNATCHER is decided case by case.
chunk_024.0x493c: ＠緑Registered hunters are covered by a substantial insurance plan for accidents in the line of duty.
chunk_024.0x4b51: ＠緑At the end of the 20th century, work began to connect the man-made islands of the Inland Sea—Port Island, Rokko Island, New Kobe International Airport, and others.
chunk_024.0x4bc6: ＠緑In the early 21st century, the 'Neo Kobe City Project' set out to merge the five separate blocks of artificial islands into one.
chunk_024.0x4c33: ＠緑Ten years later it was completed to coincide with the Kobe World Expo. It launched as a new international artificial city, taking in mass immigration from across Asia.
chunk_024.0x4ca4: ＠緑By 2040 it had earned infamy as the world's number-one crime city—'Crime-Ville'.
chunk_024.0x4d17:
＠緑▽December 1, 2042
Neo Kobe is placed under full quarantine to prevent SNATCHER contamination.
chunk_024.0x4d74: ＠緑The 'Kobe Bridge', the only link between Neo Kobe and the mainland, is shut down, and both air and sea routes fall under military and city police control.
chunk_024.0x4de1: ＠緑Crossing the bridge now requires a transit pass and a rigorous check.
chunk_024.0x4e44: ＠緑The mother computer system that governs and manages Neo Kobe City.
chunk_024.0x4e89: ＠緑It links the hundreds of computers scattered across the city, simulates the human neural network, and performs ultra-high-speed massively parallel processing—
chunk_024.0x4efe: ＠緑a 'neuron computer' type. As the hub of centralized information control, it holds every scrap of data on the city's
chunk_024.0x4f57: ＠緑individuals, corporations, and organizations, and manages finance, distribution, transport, and more day to day.
chunk_024.0x4fac: ＠緑Alphaville's software maintenance is handled by Konami Corporation, Development Division 48.
chunk_024.0x5021: ＠緑A genetically engineered strain of cedar. (The term also commonly refers to its pollen.)
chunk_024.0x5072: ＠緑Developed for military use, its pollen has a powerful radio-jamming effect.
chunk_024.0x50b5: ＠緑It is also harmful to humans; heavy inhalation causes respiratory failure and can even lead to fatal shock.
chunk_024.0x5118: ＠緑Even in small amounts, it triggers allergic reactions such as a runny nose and sneezing.
chunk_024.0x5161: ＠緑Its pollen is larger than ordinary cedar's and resembles snow, hence the name Snow Cedar.
chunk_024.0x51b0: ＠緑Highly invasive and bad for the environment, it was cleared aggressively after the war, and its numbers fell.
chunk_024.0x5209: ＠緑Even so, it still grows in great numbers, mainly in water-rich areas like the rivers of temperate to subarctic climates.
chunk_024.0x5262: ＠緑The only area in the city where Snow Cedar has been confirmed is the Ina River basin.
chunk_024.0x52af: ＠緑Because this pollen turns up in the wake of SNATCHER activity, a link between the two has drawn attention.
chunk_024.0x5336: ＠緑An unidentified disease that has spread since 2030, centered on France.
chunk_024.0x5377: ＠緑Neo Kobe's first patient was confirmed in the summer of 2035.
chunk_024.0x53b4: ＠緑There are currently 153,000 confirmed STBO cases worldwide, but latent infections are said to number five times that.
chunk_024.0x541b: ＠緑Infection brings fever, joint pain, muscle pain, diarrhea, swollen lymph nodes, convulsions, and pneumonia, with a fatality rate over 60%.
chunk_024.0x5486: ＠緑It is confirmed to spread through blood, saliva, and semen, and is thought to be transmitted most often by sexual contact and intravenous injection.
chunk_024.0x54f9: ＠緑Some say it is a mutation of the 'AIDS' virus (human T-cell leukemia virus) that spread 50 years ago, but
chunk_024.0x5566: ＠緑no effective vaccine or treatment has yet been found.
chunk_024.0x55a3: ＠緑Fueled by stimulant use and the unsanitary needles of back-alley clinics, its spread among the poor has grown severe.
chunk_024.0x5604: ＠緑This virus has broken down human contact, becoming an indirect factor in the spread of the SNATCHERs.
chunk_024.0x56d2: ＠緑Taken orally or by intravenous or subcutaneous injection. It acts strongly on the nervous system, causing excitement and visual distortion.
chunk_024.0x572f: ＠緑Synthesized to model the brain's own chemicals, it works above all to strip anxiety and fear from the user's mind.
chunk_024.0x5786: ＠緑It has spread explosively among the young since the late 2030s. It suppresses the brain's natural chemical output, and with long-term use,
chunk_024.0x57f9: ＠緑a tolerance builds, and quitting can cause central nervous system failure.
chunk_024.0x583e: ＠緑In Neo Kobe City it is controlled by Mister Big (a top-priority wanted criminal).
chunk_024.0x58a5: ＠緑Refers to the illegal market in Neo Kobe City.
chunk_024.0x58de: ＠緑Being an illegal, unlicensed market, it deals in an abundance of goods, legitimate and not.
chunk_024.0x592f: ＠緑A flood of business-minded Chinese immigrants helped the black market grow enormously.
chunk_024.0x5982: ＠緑Its scale is even said to rival the legitimate market.
chunk_024.0x59c3: ＠緑Its customers were mainly immigrants and illegal entrants from the mainland, and it served as the market of the underworld, but...
chunk_024.0x5a2e: ＠緑In recent years, drawn by its scale and low prices, ordinary citizens use it in droves, dealing a blow to the legitimate market.
chunk_024.0x5a95: ＠緑The largest black-market area in Neo Kobe is 'JOY DIVISION'.
chunk_024.0x5b52: ＠緑It carried the city's traffic for forty years after the war, but was abolished as the 'South' turned to slums and the 'Automated Traffic System' arrived.
chunk_024.0x5bbb: ＠緑The original plan was to run the train through a near-vacuum tube, building a system that cut air resistance to almost zero, but...
chunk_024.0x5c2e: ＠緑rising costs and the fragile ground of the artificial islands kept it from being realized.
chunk_024.0x5c6b: ＠緑The tunnels of the abandoned Tube Liner still remain beneath the city today.
chunk_024.0x5cc4: ＠緑Since then, due to land-ownership disputes and ground conditions, the Tube Liner ruins have been left untouched.
chunk_024.0x5d49: ＠緑A system that keeps traffic orderly by having 'Alphaville' manage every road, waterway, and air route in Neo Kobe.
chunk_024.0x5dbe: ＠緑Combined especially with Advanced Safety Vehicles (ASV), it wiped out road accidents and congestion, making traffic problems a thing of the past.
chunk_024.0x5e33: ＠緑With the arrival of this thorough automated traffic system, mass transit became unnecessary.
chunk_024.0x5ec5: ＠緑Normally 'taxi' means a driverless, computer-controlled cab run by the automated traffic system, but boarding one requires proof of citizenship
chunk_024.0x5f3a: ＠緑—without it you can't ride—and it can only be used within the centralized information-control zone, with every pickup and drop-off logged.
chunk_024.0x5f9b: ＠緑So the immigrants and illegal entrants who make up over 25% of the city's population cannot use driverless taxis.
chunk_024.0x6006: ＠緑The 'black-market taxi', by contrast, asks no questions about identity and can go anywhere in the city, making it popular with riders.
chunk_024.0x6079: ＠緑As a result, though illegal, 'black-market taxis' operate openly and are even organized.
chunk_024.0x60d8: ＠緑Given all this, the government can no longer ignore them, and from next April a new law will take effect that, for these illegal operators,...
chunk_024.0x614d: ＠緑moves toward legalization by granting operating licenses after screening.
chunk_024.0x61c0: ＠緑In the late 20th century, plans were laid to send humanity into space, but the decline of Earth's environment—through accelerating global warming, bio-hazards, and the like—
chunk_024.0x626a: ＠緑With the U.S. building the space station 'Freedom' and developing fusion rockets, humanity's push into space advanced by leaps and bounds.
chunk_024.0x62cf: ＠緑In 2010, humanity's first space colony, 'Beyond Coast', was completed, making migration to space a reality.
chunk_024.0x6330: ＠緑Today a lunar base mines helium-3 for fusion, and the push toward Mars is under way as well.
chunk_024.0x63b5: ＠緑▽August 1988: The Phobos Program surveys Mars and its moons Phobos and Deimos with Phobos 1 and 2. (USSR)
chunk_024.0x6426: ＠緑▽October 1989: The Mars Observer probe explores Mars, surveying its weather and geology. (USA)
chunk_024.0x648f: ＠緑▽1992: The Vesta Program. Exploration of Mars, asteroids, and comets.
chunk_024.0x64cc: ＠緑Initially led by the Eastern European nations, it was taken over with U.S. aid after the chaos of the Catastrophe.
chunk_024.0x651f:
＠緑▽2005
Work begins on the unmanned Martian robot factory 'Wells'.
chunk_024.0x657d:
＠緑▽2015
Work begins on the manned experimental base 'Le Guin'.
chunk_024.0x66ac: ＠緑A plan to turn the uninhabited planet Mars into a green, living land like Earth.
chunk_024.0x66f3: ＠緑First, mirrors placed in Mars orbit increase the sunlight reaching the surface, while greenhouse gases are released on the ground...
chunk_024.0x6762: ＠緑to warm Mars until yeasts and bacteria can live there.
chunk_024.0x679f: ＠緑Then, using the oxygen those yeasts and microbes produce, it is made habitable for more advanced life.
chunk_024.0x67f4: ＠緑The vast underground reserves of frozen water revealed by Martian base surveys have suddenly given this plan real credibility.
chunk_024.0x6865: ＠緑The plan now moves forward under the slogans 'From Red Planet to Green Land' and 'New Martian Colony', and as its first stage...
chunk_024.0x68d4: ＠緑the solar mirrors are scheduled to be installed in 2045.
chunk_024.0x6909: ＠緑Recently, the 'Beagle Jerusalem', carrying the first Mars survey migrant group, was launched.
chunk_024.0x698e: ＠緑Communication without language, achieved by mechanically detecting a living being's biological responses—such as the chemicals it emits—and turning them into signals.
chunk_024.0x69f9: ＠緑Communication between humans and other creatures is hoped for in the future, but for ethical reasons, for now humans only...
chunk_024.0x6a6e:
＠緑observe and study other creatures—it stays one-way.
The workings of vertebrate consciousness, meanwhile,...

chunk_024.0x77db: ＠緑Taking the 'SNATCHER contamination' in Neo Kobe City gravely, the government declared the city a contaminated zone,
chunk_024.0x7840: ＠緑and the cabinet resolved to forcibly seal off every land and sea route except the Neo Kobe Bridge.
chunk_024.0x7897: ＠緑It was put into effect on December 1, 2042.
chunk_024.0x78ca: ＠緑This halted contamination of other regions, but deepened the city's isolation.
chunk_024.0x791d: ＠緑Yet the SNATCHER problem has reached the present day with no fundamental solution in sight.
chunk_024.0x7990: ＠緑Since the 2020 'Multiethnic City Declaration', many peoples and races have migrated to Neo Kobe City, but this inevitably...
chunk_024.0x7a05: ＠緑came to split society and open a divide between rich and poor.
chunk_024.0x7a34: ＠緑The wealthy long-time residents settled mainly around the government district in the city's north, while the poor newcomers took root in the developing areas of the south.
chunk_024.0x7aa9: ＠緑What spurred this trend was the flood of immigrants who poured in after 'The Catastrophe'.
chunk_024.0x7af8: ＠緑As they built up the so-called 'underworld', the city came to hold two societies—the 'North' and the 'South'.
chunk_024.0x7b89: ＠緑The homeless (Freemen) who live having erased their personal data from the databanks of the state and community.
chunk_024.0x7bf0: ＠緑In today's highly information-driven age, erasing one's registered data is to deny one's social existence, and the rise of 'Freemen'...
chunk_024.0x7c5d: ＠緑is having a serious impact in places, as a matter of public order and labor.
chunk_024.0x7c98: ＠緑Those who become 'Freemen' are often people in computer-network professions, making it a new problem of the information age.
chunk_024.0x7d0d: ＠緑The Freemen mostly settle in areas outside information control and underground in the ruins of the Tube Liner.
chunk_024.0x7d80: ＠緑Having lost their homeland to 'The Catastrophe', the Eurasian population fled outward, giving rise to the problem of mass immigration.
chunk_024.0x7ddf: ＠緑Chinese immigrants were especially numerous; some 100,000 poured into Japan over a total of five waves.
chunk_024.0x7e30: ＠緑The Japanese government concentrated most of the immigrants it took in within Neo Kobe City, which then billed itself a 'multiethnic city'.
chunk_024.0x7e9b: ＠緑As a result, the Chinese became the city's second-largest population after the Japanese, but their standard of living was low, and most of them...
chunk_024.0x7f08: ＠緑are forced to live in the slums of the 'South'.
chunk_024.0x7f3d: ＠緑Many Chinese immigrants resent this, and most of them have become an underground force, forming an underworld beyond the reach of the authorities.

chunk_024.0x8023: ＠緑Its main theme is the question of resource ownership in the Siberian neutral zone, but with the SNATCHER problem also on the agenda, it has the media abuzz.
chunk_024.0x8094: ＠緑SNATCHER contamination has the whole world's attention, yet there have been no SNATCHER sightings in any city outside Neo Kobe...

chunk_024.0x81e5: ＠緑Neo Kobe is split between the centralized information-managed zone, run by fiber optics and satellites, and the slum areas that slipped through that control.
